description: NSE capital-market trading holidays. Populated from the NSE 2026 holiday list (verify against nseindia.com -> Resources -> Holiday List each quarter; Islamic-calendar dates can shift). 2026-10-26 is Diwali Laxmi Pujan: regular session closed, only evening Muhurat trading (not covered by this tool). 2026-01-15 was an extra closure for Maharashtra municipal elections.
